hq_country: United States (Louisville, KY) / United Kingdom (parent Linnworks)
target_vertical: Multi-channel e-commerce retailer / DTC brand; warehouse-centric operations
pricing_model: Tiered by monthly order volume and user count; custom quote on enterprise; no percentage-of-revenue fees
starting_price_usd: Growth plan approximately $299/month (annual billing) for 2 users and ~2,000 orders/month; Pro plan ~$449/month [uncertain]
free_trial_or_freemium: No public free trial; demo-led sales process [uncertain]
shopify_install_count: Very few public reviews on Shopify App Store (~1 review reported); broader product has 80+ Capterra reviews [uncertain]
shopify_plus_partner_status: Markets Shopify Plus integration page on linnworks.com/skuvault.com, but explicit Shopify Plus Certified App Partner directory listing not confirmed [uncertain]
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional: inventory pushed from SkuVault to Shopify; orders pulled from Shopify to SkuVault; product/listing data primarily SkuVault -> Shopify
shopify_synced_entities: Products, variants, inventory quantities, orders, fulfillments/tracking; customer data limited. Shopify POS orders also flow into SkuVault.
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes — all SkuVault subscribers can connect unlimited Shopify stores at no additional charge
shopify_pos_support: Supported: Shopify POS orders sync to SkuVault for fulfillment and inventory decrement; retail location inventory tracked alongside warehouse
shopify_variant_option_mapping: SKU-based variant mapping; each Shopify variant maps to a SkuVault SKU/product record
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Near real-time inventory and order sync (webhook + scheduled polling); exact frequency not publicly documented [uncertain]
shopify_known_limitations: Recent Shopify App Store reviews report sync issues and unresolved support cases; UI/UX considered outdated; sync errors during high-volume periods reported on Capterra/G2; landed cost not synced; service/non-physical items handling not documented
etsy_native_or_third_party: Direct integration listed on linnworks.com/integrations/etsy; some configurations route through Listing Mirror partner [uncertain]
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: Primarily inventory and order sync; listing creation typically via Listing Mirror partner integration [uncertain]
etsy_inventory_sync: Real-time inventory sync to prevent overselling across Etsy and other channels; minimum stock levels and quantity buffers supported
etsy_order_import: Automated order import from Etsy into SkuVault for picking/packing/fulfillment
etsy_synced_entities: Listings (limited create), variations, inventory, orders, shipments/tracking [uncertain]
etsy_known_limitations: Personalization fields and digital product handling not documented; advanced listing-creation typically requires Listing Mirror add-on [uncertain]
amazon_marketplaces: Major Amazon marketplaces supported (US, UK, EU, CA); exact list not publicly itemized [uncertain]
amazon_seller_types: FBM primary; FBA inventory visibility supported; Vendor Central support [uncertain]
amazon_synced_entities: Listings, inventory, orders, shipments/tracking; settlements and customer messaging not core features [uncertain]
amazon_listing_creation: Sync existing listings primarily; listing creation typically via Listing Mirror or sister Linnworks product [uncertain]
amazon_known_limitations: Less emphasized than Linnworks (parent) for full Amazon listing/repricing depth; SkuVault Core focus is WMS rather than channel management
xero_app_store_certified: Listed via third-party connectors (e.g. APIWORX); no first-party SkuVault Core Xero app on Xero App Store confirmed [uncertain]
xero_synced_entities: Via APIWORX or similar middleware: orders, inventory, invoices, customer records; bills and journal posting via custom mapping [uncertain]
xero_known_limitations: Native Xero integration not a primary feature; relies on third-party iPaaS partners
qb_desktop_supported: Yes — both QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop supported; Desktop typically via DBSync/connector partners
qb_app_certified: Listed on Intuit App Store status not confirmed [uncertain]
qb_synced_entities: Customers, products, sales (sales receipts/invoices), suppliers/vendors, purchase orders, inventory adjustments; line-by-line inventory decrement on sale
qb_known_limitations: Deeper QBO field/class mapping typically requires DBSync, Minding My Books or APIWORX middleware; native first-party app depth limited
other_ecom_channels: Shopify, Shopify POS, Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Etsy, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, Volusion, Shift4Shop, Lightspeed Retail, Square POS, OpenCart, X-Cart, SureDone, NetSuite, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Rithum (formerly ChannelAdvisor)
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes — kits/bundles with component-level inventory decrement; Just-in-Time (JIT) kitting and Assembled Products (pre-built kits with physical removal of components) both supported
other_accounting_integrations: QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, NetSuite (via integrations/middleware); Sage / MYOB / Zoho Books not natively listed [uncertain]
bom_support: Yes via kits/assembled products; not a traditional manufacturing BOM with routings
multi_level_bom: Limited — primarily single-level kits/bundles; multi-level nesting not documented [uncertain]
production_orders: No traditional work-order/routing system; Just-in-Time kitting workflow approximates light assembly
batch_lot_tracking: Yes — lot tracking with expiry dates for perishables
serial_tracking: Yes — serial number tracking from receiving to shipping
bin_location_support: Yes — warehouse zones, groups, and bin types with stock-transfer tracking
multi_warehouse: Yes — real-time visibility across multiple physical locations
barcoding: Yes — barcode generation, label printing, and scanning workflows
purchase_orders: Yes — PO creation, supplier info, lead time tracking, cost capture
supplier_management: Yes — supplier records with lead times and supplier-to-SKU mapping
landed_cost_support: No — landed cost tracking is not built in; identified as a gap by reviewers
ai_demand_forecasting: Yes — AI Replenishment Reporting uses a probabilistic model to forecast demand, factoring sales velocity, seasonality, and lead times
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Yes — intelligent Replenishment Report generates custom-tailored POs based on forecasted demand
public_api: Yes — RESTful API documented at dev.skuvault.com with OAuth 2.0; reference at dev.skuvault.com/reference
webhook_event_coverage: Webhooks API exists; specific event-coverage detail not fully published [uncertain]
integration_architecture: native marketplace connectors + iPaaS partners (APIWORX, DBSync, Listing Mirror) for deeper accounting/marketplace mapping
mobile_app: Web-based mobile interface optimized for handheld scanners; Android and iPhone compatibility; dedicated native app status unclear [uncertain]
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes — web-based mobile app pairs with barcode scanners for pick/pack/stocktake; partners like ScanSKU sell dedicated Android scanners pre-configured
sync_frequency: Near real-time for Shopify/Amazon/eBay inventory and orders; exact cadence per channel not publicly stated [uncertain]
shipping_carrier_integrations: Primarily via ShipStation (200+ carriers including USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, Royal Mail, Australia Post, Canada Post, DPD); also ShipEngine; direct carrier integrations limited
shipping_label_buying: Via ShipStation/ShipEngine partnership — labels printed directly from SkuVault workflow; not a free in-app label-buying product like Amazon Veeqo
g2_rating: Listed on G2 under Linnworks/SkuVault; mixed feedback citing strong channel integration and support concerns post-acquisition; specific star rating not captured [uncertain]
notable_customers: Reported metrics: clients decrease out-of-stocks by 90%, labor costs by 30%, fulfillment time by 87% on average; specific named customers not surfaced [uncertain]
last_major_release: Rebranded as SkuVault Core under Linnworks umbrella post-2022 acquisition; ongoing integration with Linnworks platform [uncertain]
owner_parent_company: Linnworks (acquired SkuVault September 2022); Marlin Equity Partners is majority shareholder of combined company
last_funding_event: Acquisition by Linnworks/Marlin Equity Partners completed September 1, 2022; terms undisclosed
